notes: Upstream-clone legacy C modernisation: id-Software/DOOM linuxdoom-1.10 (1997) must compile against gcc 13/glibc 2.39 and the resulting binary must boot headless under Xvfb and play a fixed recorded demo to completion. The failure surface is broad and unlabelled (missing libc5-era headers, TLS errno clash, pointer-in-int config tables, 64-bit pointer truncation and pointer-array sizing, a fortify-exposed 1-byte overflow in IWAD path) and the -O2 hidden build config exposes a crash that the baseline -g build does not, so flag-blind fixes that merely silence the default build lose the hidden cases. Oracle fixes 7 files with a 29/28 line diff, verified across three flag sets and three demo fixtures.
